families.label: Card number (PAN) in agent context
families.description: A card primary account number reached an agent prompt or tool result. DLP inspects the turn before it leaves the sandbox.

families.label: NRIC / FIN in agent context
families.description: A Singapore NRIC or FIN number reached an agent prompt or tool result.

families.label: Data exfiltration
families.description: A transfer of sensitive data toward a destination outside the CUE egress allow-list.

families.label: SWIFT payment message in agent context
families.description: An MT103 or pacs.008 customer credit transfer reached an agent prompt.

families.label: Secret in prompt
families.description: An API key, token, private key or connection string in a prompt or file sent to the model.

families.label: Prohibited AI service
families.description: Traffic to a service labelled Prohibited in Discover (data residency).

families.label: Sensitive file access
families.description: Access to a secret, judged by file content rather than filename or path.

families.label: Undisclosed action
families.description: The agent did more than it declared; the engine cross-checks the declared manifest against what it observed.
